      procedure, nopass :: sum
   end type SimpleSum

contains
      procedure, pass :: sum
   end type SimpleSum

replacements.paper:
function sum{INumeric :: T}(x) result(s)
      type(T), intent(in) :: x(:)
replacements.reason: TD-36 exact_pass: SimpleSum's stateless sum receives, and ignores, an intent(in) passed object of its sealed type

preservation: Copy of the companion file, including the original module names, whitespace, the generic PairwiseSum{ISum :: U} and Averager{ISum :: U} definitions, type(U) allocatable fields, initial :: constructors that use U without redeclaring it, methods with independent T binders, inferred constructor chaining and the program's READ/SELECT CASE driver with the runtime class(IAverager) variable. The only changes are the TD-36 explicit-receiver migration recorded in receiver_migration; reverting its replacements, in reverse order, reproduces original_sha256.
